items.t: 22 houses sold in Holly, Ladner at a median of $1,417,000 (middle half $1,197,375 to $1,571,250). A typical house in Holly, Ladner spent 18 days on the market and closed at 96.4% of the asking price.
In Holly, Ladner, townhomes sold at a median of $874,950 across 8 sales, and the middle half closed between $858,750 and $932,500. The median townhome sat 36 days and sold for 99.2% of list.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Holly compares with the rest of Ladner

items.t: Houses in Holly have the highest median of the 6 Ladner sub-areas, $1,417,000, ahead of Port Guichon at $1,369,500; the lowest is Ladner Elementary at $1,140,000.

Of 5 Ladner sub-areas with 5 or more townhome sales, Holly ranks second highest at $874,950; the range is $702,500 (Hawthorne) to $1,090,000 (Neilsen Grove). Delta Manor ($860,000) sits just below and Neilsen Grove ($1,090,000) sits just above.
